name: Leandrop
description: Pinch the blade spine between thumb and forefinger and toss it point-first so it flies flat and straight to the mark.

name: Hard Hiltweight
description: Raise the throwing hand beside the ear and snap the wrist forward so the knife flies point-first at the chest.

name: Balanceblade Drop
description: Swing the arm up from the hip in a short arc and release so the knife climbs into the thigh.

name: Stepping Bladeflat
description: Drop back onto the rear heel as the knife leaves the fingers to win one pace of distance from a closing foe.

name: Sharp Lodge
description: Throw one knife and a second one beat later so both blades strike close together on the same mark.

name: Downward Spinthrow
description: Pull the top knife from the belt row with the thumb and throw it in one motion without looking down.

name: Shivstrike
description: Lay the forefinger along the spine and let it slide off last so the blade leaves the hand without wobble.

name: Throwtang Strike
description: Open the hand fully at release so the blade drops forward of the fingertips with no sideways spin.

name: Stickblow
description: Keep hold of the knife and whip the wrist over to slash the forearm of a hand that grabs for you.

name: Leanreview
description: Throw one knife at a plank to learn how the blade's weight carries at this range before using the rest.

name: Backward Flickthrow
description: Step off the line of a charging foe with a quarter turn while keeping the knife hand cocked and ready.

name: Open Weighttang
description: Release from a short grip so the blade turns exactly once and sticks point-first at about three paces.

name: Narrow Spineweight
description: Release from a mid-blade grip so the knife turns twice and lands point-first at the next range band.

name: Long Pointguard
description: Hold the knife by the pommel and send it with a long arm sweep so it turns three times to a far mark.

name: Even Spinetip
description: Count the paces to the target in one glance and choose the grip that matches the distance.

name: Firm Edgeflat
description: Drop into a crouch then rise through the throw so the leg drive adds force to a short flat flight.

name: Shivpause
description: Throw at the rail or post beside a foe's hand so the sudden thud breaks the foe's grip timing.

name: Swaying Edgeflat
description: Cross the rear foot behind and spin away from a grapple while the blade hand stays free to throw.

name: Stiff Spinthrow
description: Plant both feet square to the post and throw with the shoulders level so the knife flies true to center.

name: Level Stick
description: Spread the feet and swing the arm in a wide flat sweep to loose the blade at waist height.

name: Quick Flight
description: Use only forearm and wrist tendons in a quick flick that sends the knife a short hard distance.

name: Lodgehit
description: Hold the elbow locked straight and pull from the shoulder so the blade carries far and level.

name: Thunkblow
description: Throw sidearm with the weaker hand so a thrower is not helpless when the strong arm is held.

name: Ready Throwgrip
description: Hold the knife edge-out near the shoulder and knock aside a small thrown stone or a blade.

name: Balanceblade Dash
description: Throw on the rising half of each breath so the body is steady and the aim does not drift.

name: Swaying Thunk
description: Pivot on the ball of the front foot back into the square stance after a throw to be ready again.

name: Single Weighttang
description: Throw at the chalk ring on a post and call each hit so the count teaches steady aim.

name: Bladeflat Drop
description: Release with a firm stop of the arm that the bones absorb so the blade leaves with full force.

name: Sharp Throwtang
description: Throw ten knives in a steady rhythm with one pause each so strength and aim hold to the last.

name: Lodgedrop
description: Aim ahead of a walking target by a stride so the blade arrives where the target will be.

name: Solid Spineweight
description: Sweep the knife flat across the hip to turn a low blow away from the belly.

name: Sideways Lodge
description: Break the count and step wide when a foe closes so the pattern is not read and the foe overshoots.

name: Shivbump
description: Let a thread of qi warm the throwing hand and send the knife point-first with a clean steady flight.

name: Calm Spinetip
description: Hold a thin thread of qi along the blade through release so the flight stays level farther than muscle alone.

name: Lodgedash
description: Push a short pulse of qi into the fingers at release so the blade leaves faster than the arm moves.

name: Square Flickthrow
description: Anchor the spine of the blade against the thumb and turn the whole body into a strong flat throw.

name: Lodgestay
description: Throw close past a lamp so the draft of the blade snuffs its flame and darkens the foe's sight.

name: Easing Throwgrip
description: Send qi to the soles and slide backward in one smooth step while the knife hand keeps its aim.

name: Raised Pointguard
description: Turn the wrist in a small ring of qi to knock an incoming blade off its line.

name: Forward Pointguard
description: Hold the breath at the top of the draw and loose the blade at the pause for a still aim.

name: Sharp Bladeflat
description: Let the breath out in a short hiss as the arm drives so the qi pulse adds reach to the throw.

name: Sharp Stick
description: Throw one knife on each out-breath across a row of marks while the qi circulates in a steady cycle.

name: Shivpace
description: Take a short sip of air and step aside on it so the foe's lunge goes past the shoulder.

name: Deep Spineweight
description: Slow the breath for three counts to feel the foe's weight shift and pick the next throw's mark.

name: Descending Hiltweight
description: Aim a hand's width high and add a lifting wrist when throwing uphill so the knife does not fall short.

name: Thunkbump
description: Aim low and shorten the arc when throwing downhill so the knife does not sail over the mark.

name: Flightbump
description: Aim into a side draft by a hand's width and drive harder so the blade is not pushed wide.

name: Sudden Balanceblade
description: Throw at the end of a running stride with the shoulder square so the blade keeps its line.

name: Quiet Thunk
description: Plant the lead foot flat and the rear toe in loose ground so footing holds through the throw.

name: Slimblow
description: Rise from behind low cover for one snap throw and drop back before the foe can answer.

name: Steady Weighttang
description: Catch the glint on the blade at dusk to judge its turn and tell how far it will carry.

name: Snug Spinetip
description: Use the flat of the held knife against the boot-top to turn aside a low cut at the knee.

name: Flat Flight
description: Roll the loaded wrist through the release so the knife gains a hard fast spin.

name: Slimreview
description: Lift a small stone slowly with qi flowing to the wrist to build the strength a fast flick needs.

name: Stiff Hiltweight
description: Flick the wrist so fast that the thrown blade slices a hanging reed clean through.

name: Low Thunk
description: Snap the cuff-side wrist outward at the last instant so the blade jumps off the fingers.

name: Angled Edgeflat
description: Brace the strong forearm across the body and turn a blow aside with a strike of qi-hardened wrist.

name: Shivnote
description: Squeeze and release the grip to push tired qi out of the hand and restore the feel of the blade.

name: Slimgauge
description: Pull a knife free from a post with a quick qi grip and turn straight into the next throw.

name: Downward Throwgrip
description: Scoop a fallen knife from the dirt in one sweep of the hand and throw it as the arm rises.

name: Lodgestrike
description: Pass a knife from the off hand to the throwing hand mid-turn and loose it without a pause.

name: Shivgauge
description: Scan the floor and frame with one sweep of the eyes to mark where each thrown blade has fallen.

name: Sideways Throwtang
description: Let a spent blade lie and step past it into a new position rather than stoop and lose a beat.

name: Forward Flight
description: Catch a knife as it bounces from a hard wall at the right angle and send it out again.

name: Narrow Lodge
description: Slide a fresh blade from the sleeve sheath into the palm and throw it before the foe moves.
